sources.label: DataMeet maps (Census 2011 districts, Assembly and Parliamentary constituencies)
sources.notes: DataMeet community maps repo, CC-BY-SA 2.5 IN. Backs districts.geojson (dists11.geojson filtered DISTRICT=Kolkata), acs.geojson (ac.geojson filtered DIST_NAME=KOLKATA, ACs 158-168), pcs.geojson (pc_14.geojson filtered to Kolkata Uttar/Dakshin). The ac.geojson and pc_14.geojson URLs are recorded verbatim in the same file. Also the AC/PC inputs to the derived jurisdiction_crosswalk.json (spatial join of ward/AC/PC layers, per the crosswalk's own embedded source field).

sources.label: DataMeet Municipal_Spatial_Data — KMC ward polygons (via J. Meyers/DataMeet thread)
sources.notes: CC-BY-SA 2.5 IN; 141 of 144 KMC wards (142-144 missing, no open geometry found). Backs wards.geojson, ward_heat.geojson and ward_heat_summary.json (ward frames), the ward input to jurisdiction_crosswalk.json, and the borough dissolve used for subdistricts (data-side).

sources.label: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API
sources.notes: ODbL 1.0; provenance records list the Overpass filters and bbox (S22.40 W88.20 N22.70 E88.50) but record no resource URL (resource_url is null on disk) — honest blank. Backs roads.geojson, metro_lines.geojson, metro.geojson (stations), stops.geojson (bus stops), health.geojson (hospitals; features carry osm_id), schools.geojson, libraries.geojson, toilets.geojson, police.geojson, and suburban_rail.geojson (separate record flags it NON-AUTHORITATIVE, illustrative first pass).

sources.label: WorldPop wpgppop 2020 stats API
sources.notes: CC-BY 4.0. Per-ward population_2020 property written onto wards.geojson and carried into ward_heat.geojson; covers the 141 wards with geometry.

sources.label: WB SUDA / Presidency University quality audit of 40 functional NULM shelter homes (2023)
sources.notes: Sole source for shelters.geojson — all 6 Kolkata features carry this URL in their per-feature source field, with geocode-confidence and site-visit notes embedded per feature (6 NULM-registered shelters, 437 beds).

sources.label: DAY-NULM Scheme of Shelters for Urban Homeless (SUH) operational guidelines
sources.notes: PRIMARY-VERIFIED 2026-07-01 (Section 3.1, printed p. 2); local copy at data/sources/nulm-suh-guidelines-day-nulm-2019.pdf. Provides the shelter-capacity norm behind the Kolkata shortfall benchmark (~90% short, 437 beds vs ~4,497 norm-implied) that contextualizes shelters.geojson.

sources.label: Landsat Collection-2 Level-2 (Landsat 8/9) via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC API
sources.notes: Derivation source for the heat layers: heat30m.png, heat30m_bounds.json, ward_heat.geojson (lst fields) and ward_heat_summary.json (window 2024-04-01/2026-07-01 recorded in the summary). Adapter queries collection landsat-c2-l2, platforms landsat-8/9, ST_B10/lwir11 surface-temperature band; quarterly refresh wired in .github/workflows/heat-refresh.yml.

sources.label: Kolkata Municipal Corporation official site (kmcgov.in) — councillor pages, budget books, facility PDFs
sources.notes: Backs the councillor names on ward_heat.geojson/wards (councillors, councillor_count from Councillors2-10.jsp; wards 1-15 via the SEC-result transcription because Councillors1.jsp 404s), plus data-side KMC budget PDF index (FY2022-23 to 2026-27, HTTP-verified 2026-06-09), health/school/parks facility PDFs, and the Mayors page. Individual document URLs recorded in budget_index.json and facilities/README.md.

sources.label: 2021 KMC election result — WB State Election Commission via Wikipedia transcription
sources.notes: Backs councillor_parties on ward_heat.geojson and the council-status facts (AITC 134/144). Integrity note on disk: the official SEC PDF at wbsec.gov.in was unreachable (expired TLS, HTTP 503) on 2026-06-09, so party data rests on Wikipedia's transcription; inferred-party rows are flagged AITC* pending SEC verification.

sources.label: Census 2011 Primary Census Abstract for Slum (PCA-Slum), ORGI NADA catalog 6190
sources.notes: Kolkata (M Corp.) slum population 1,409,721 (31.35% of 4,496,694) with MD5-verified source XLS. Backs no public layer file directly; the city_total_population_2011 figure underpins the shelter-shortfall benchmark in docs/nulm-shelter-shortfall-findings.md. Data-side record.

sources.label: WBPCB primary records (employee roster, RTI finance reply) + CPR SPCB study working papers
sources.notes: Regulator-capacity source set: WBPCB April-2022 employee roster and RTI finance reply held locally in source/pollution/raw/, plus CPR finances/staff working papers, the CPR RTI-response zip, wbpcb.gov.in, and a Down To Earth Rajya Sabha-answer article (all URLs recorded in the sources file). Backs NO public Kolkata layer file yet — grep of public/cities/kolkata/index.html finds zero WBPCB mentions; acquired for the pollution/regulator-capacity layer.

sources.label: Officer-appointment press records (APAC News Network; Deccan Herald)
sources.notes: Backs the municipal-commissioner (Anshul Gupta, IAS) and police-commissioner names in data/cities/kolkata/layers/governance.json (data-side governance card; not one of the public layer files). Per-record source URLs on disk in officers.json.

sources.label: Anwesha Ghosh, Municipal Calcutta: Urban Governance in a Colonial City (UofT PhD)
sources.notes: No URL recorded on disk — honest blank; local PDF at data/sources/ghosh-2020-municipal-calcutta-uoft-thesis.pdf, Zotero key I6363ZWJ noted in the reading file. Grep of public/cities/kolkata/index.html finds no Ghosh citation, so it currently backs no public Kolkata layer or claim; it is an interpretive reference under close reading.

sources.label: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API — Kolkata suburban rail geometry rebuild
sources.notes: ODbL 1.0. Backs suburban_rail.geojson and suburban_rail_stations.geojson after the July 2026 rebuild. Rail lines use railway=rail over bbox S21.50 W86.00 N24.50 E89.90; station points are matched against the saved Kolkata Suburban station membership snapshot to avoid inflating the layer with every rail station in the broad bbox. Non-authoritative geometry; route membership still needs official railway timetable/GTFS verification.

sources.label: Wikipedia — List of Kolkata Suburban Railway stations
sources.notes: Secondary station-membership snapshot used only to filter OSM station geometry for the Kolkata suburban station layer. The saved table had 411 rows; 346 rows matched OSM station geometry in this build. It is not treated as official timetable, GTFS, or authoritative railway publication.

sources.label: Eastern Railway — SDAH Suburban Tracking System page
sources.notes: Official Eastern Railway page for the Sealdah suburban tracking system, saved as a source lead. It corroborates an official ER digital suburban-tracking surface but was not a downloadable static GTFS or station geometry dataset in this build.

sources.label: MobilityData — Indian Railways GTFS city extract for Kolkata local/EMU services
sources.notes: Unofficial MobilityData Indian Railways GTFS archive. Backs suburban_rail_gtfs_stations.geojson (438) and suburban_rail_gtfs_routes.geojson (1563) using Kolkata-region bbox plus LOCAL/EMU/MEMU filters. It is a schedule lead, not an official Eastern/South Eastern Railway GTFS disclosure.

sources.label: Metro Railway Kolkata timetable-derived GTFS
sources.notes: Backs metro_gtfs_stops.geojson (57) and metro_gtfs_routes.geojson (5). This is an unofficial skeleton GTFS generated from Metro Railway Kolkata public line/timetable context, OSM station geometry, and two coordinate fallbacks for missing OSM station points; it is not an agency-published GTFS feed.

sources.label: WBTC city-bus route-table constructed GTFS
sources.notes: Backs bus_stops.geojson (192) and bus_routes.geojson (130). Constructed from the official WBTC City Bus Routes table archived on 2026-07-04 plus local OSM bus-stop geometry and source-backed transit anchor points from Kolkata private-bus, metro, and suburban-rail layers; not an agency-published GTFS feed. The builder now skips 1 WBTC route row with fewer than two matched anchors and records it in provenance.

sources.label: Kolkata regulated private-bus OSM route-relation constructed GTFS
sources.notes: Backs regulated_private_bus_stops.geojson (810 endpoint stops) and regulated_private_bus_routes.geojson (405 routes). Constructed on 2026-07-04 from OSM route relations tagged network=Kolkata Private Bus; endpoint stops come from relation from/to tags and relation way endpoints, not agency stop-level schedules. This is not an agency-published GTFS feed.
